trailhead.label: Junction for Kandellen, Frondeigen and the Silvestertal above Wahlen, the board’s start

waypoints.label: Drinking water on the way down above Wahlen

cautions: Heat risk is high on this walk: start early and carry extra water.
Steep grass slopes up to the Golfen with no clear path in places.
About 9 km of open ridge above 2,400 m, mountain-hiking ground (SAC T2), far from shelter in a storm.
About 4 km on roads, the last kilometre on asphalt.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
